description: This file contains utility functions and types for managing Pi's compaction settings, including applying overrides based on configuration, resolving floor values, and controlling auto-compaction behavior.

methods.name: ensurePiCompactionReserveTokens
methods.description: Ensures the reserve tokens meet a minimum floor, applying overrides if necessary.

methods.name: resolveCompactionReserveTokensFloor
methods.description: Resolves the reserve tokens floor from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: applyPiCompactionSettingsFromConfig
methods.description: Applies compaction settings from configuration, overriding current settings as needed.

methods.name: shouldDisablePiAutoCompaction
methods.description: Determines if Pi's auto-compaction should be disabled based on context ownership.

methods.name: applyPiAutoCompactionGuard
methods.description: Disables Pi auto-compaction if the context owns compaction, via settings manager.
